name: Accursed
traitsHtml:
• Age:.

    Accursed that strongly resemble other humanoids might have a longevity only slightly different than those other folk. However, unusual Accursed might age quickly or live effectively ageless lives until cut down by tragedy.

Traditional Accursed Traits.

The unique nature behind your creation or the evolution of your exceedingly rare kind dictates the traits that define you. If you resemble or once lived as one of the standard heritages of Etharis, you might choose one or more of the traits of that heritage as a starting point. But you are free to choose any traits as you determine, creating a character whose unique nature shapes their experience in the world.

name: Arisen
traitsHtml:
• Age:.

    Some Arisen age slowly, their artificial nature sloughing off the worst effects of age. Others age more quickly, worn down by unnatural magic that imbues them. Arisen may live into their second or third century, or decline well before their sixtieth year.

Traditional Arisen Traits.

The artificial forms that all Arisen share often establish the baseline of their talents and instincts.

• Age:.

    Laneshi mature quickly, reaching adulthood at around 14, and can live up to 150 years.

Selecting the traditional traits noted for your heritage is quick and easy, and creates a character who feels like a solid archetype within your chosen heritage. name: Ogresh
traitsHtml:
• Age:.

    Ogresh reach maturity around age 25 but are considered youthful by their kin for decades afterward. They can live as long as 300 years.

Traditional Ogresh Traits.

A wandering lifestyle, and an innate ability to read other creatures, shapes and defines many Ogresh.

name: Wechselkind
traitsHtml:
• Age:.

    Wechselkind do not age as normal creatures do, forever trapped in the doll-like visage of their creation. Their maximum age is a function of natural wear and damage, and they are immune to magical aging effects.

Traditional Wechselkind Traits.

The magical and artificial nature shapes the aptitudes and innate features of all Wechselkind.

Combat Traits:.
  • Creature Cover|GrimHollowPG24
  • Magical Fortification|GrimHollowPG24
Exploration Traits:.

  • Helping Hand|GrimHollowPG24
  • Pass Through|GrimHollowPG24
Roleplaying Traits:.
  • Magical Savvy|GrimHollowPG24|Magical Savant (Disguise Self)
  • Magical Savvy|GrimHollowPG24 (Minor Illusion)
  • Intuitive Acrobat|GrimHollowPG24

name: Wulven
traitsHtml:
• Age:.

    Wulven mature at the same rate as others of their original heritage, but the magic that spawns them lessens the debilitating effects of aging, and they remain fit even in their later years.

Traditional Wulven Traits.

Many Wulven channel the natural instincts—and often the natural fierceness—of the creature their curse links them to.

Combat Traits:.
  • Hunter's Instinct|GrimHollowPG24
  • Natural Attack|GrimHollowPG24 (Claws)
  • Pack Hunter|GrimHollowPG24
Exploration Traits:.

  • Climber|GrimHollowPG24
Roleplaying Traits:.

  • Inborn Perception|GrimHollowPG24
  • Nature's Voice|GrimHollowPG24
